question: How can I request a product quotation or scheduled demonstration?
answer:
You can request a tailored quotation or live on-site demonstration through any of the following channels:

  • Online Demo Request: Complete the 'Request a Demo' form on this website with your shed dimensions and rearing batch schedule.
  • Regional Coordination Hubs: Contact or visit our regional field offices in Bengaluru, Mysuru, Kolar, or Sidlaghatta.
  • On-Site Technical Evaluation: Our field engineers will inspect your facility, evaluate electrical capacity, and provide a comprehensive equipment proposal.

question: Which sensors and hardware devices are compatible?
answer:
The platform supports open agricultural and industrial IoT hardware standards:

  • Supported Sensor Probes: Industrial RS-485 Modbus RTU and digital I²C sensors including Sensirion SHT3x/SHT4x, Winsen MQ-135, BH1750 lux meters, and Dallas DS18B20 temperature probes.
  • Actuator Controllers: 4-channel solid-state contactors (rated up to 16A @ 230V AC), zero-crossing AC PWM light dimmers (up to 1,000W), and reversible ventilation blowers.
  • Hardware Cryptography: Dual-core ESP32-S3 edge controllers secured with hardware cryptographic elements and mTLS X.509 device certificates.

question: How are microclimate alerts delivered to farmers?
answer:
When environmental conditions deviate beyond safe developmental margins, the platform broadcasts multi-tier instant notifications:

  • WhatsApp Text Notifications: One-line plain-language summary with real-time temperature/humidity and stage targets.
  • WhatsApp Audio Voice Notes: Naturally spoken voice notes in the farmer's preferred regional language (Kannada, Telugu, or English).
  • Mobile App Push Notifications: High-priority visual and haptic alerts on the SeriCare mobile application.
  • Urgent Cellular SMS: Offline cellular SMS failover if mobile data is disabled or cellular coverage is limited.

question: Does automated control require special or proprietary equipment?
answer:
No. SeriCare is engineered to retrofit directly onto standard sericulture rearing infrastructure:

  • Standard Equipment Compatibility: Operates seamlessly with conventional desert evaporative coolers, room heaters, ceiling fans, and fogging machines.
  • Standard 230V AC Relays: Connects to electrical appliances using standard industrial 230V AC contactors without proprietary plugs or wiring.
  • Mutual Exclusion Hardware Guard: Physical interlock relays prevent simultaneous heater and cooler operation, protecting equipment and saving electricity.

question: Is continuous internet connectivity required for shed operation?
answer:
No. Continuous internet connectivity is not required for real-time shed climate control:

  • Autonomous Edge Execution: The Setu IoT Gateway contains an on-board decision engine running closed-loop PID regulation completely locally.
  • Local Telemetry Buffering: Up to 72 hours of timestamped sensor telemetry is buffered in non-volatile flash memory during rural cellular outages.
  • Automatic Cloud Reconciliation: Once Wi-Fi or cellular connectivity is restored, all buffered packets seamlessly synchronize with the central PostgreSQL database.

question: Which environmental parameters are measured and managed?
answer:
The platform actively monitors and manages four critical physical parameters essential for larval growth and cocoon quality:

  • Temperature Control: ±0.2°C precision via dual-redundant Sensirion SHT31 industrial probes, preventing heat shock and larval stagnation.
  • Relative Humidity: ±1.5% RH precision hygrometry regulating ultrasonic cold-mist foggers and evaporative cooling pads.
  • Bed Air Quality & Gases: Real-time detection of carbon dioxide (CO₂) and toxic ammonia fumes using pre-calibrated Winsen MQ-135 sensors.
  • Circadian Illuminance: 0–65,535 Lux sensing via BH1750 digital sensors, maintaining optimal photoperiods for synchronized larval feeding.
Automated Actuation: Industrial optocoupled controllers regulate evaporative coolers, heating elements, ultrasonic foggers, exhaust ventilation fans, and zero-crossing PWM lighting.

question: How do I obtain technical support for active installations?
answer:
Active subscribers and hardware owners receive comprehensive multi-channel technical support:

  • Direct Helpdesk & WhatsApp Support: Rapid assistance for system configuration, threshold adjustments, and firmware updates.
  • Regional Field Technician Dispatch: Certified field technicians dispatched from local district clusters (Ramanagara, Sidlaghatta, Chikkaballapura, Mysuru) under guaranteed SLA resolution windows.
  • Hardware Warranty & Calibration: Regular sensor probe re-calibration checks and on-site replacement for covered hardware components.

question: How does the on-site installation process work?
answer:
Turnkey on-site deployment is executed by certified SeriCare field technicians in a structured 5-step process (typically 3 to 5 hours):

  • 1. Shed Thermal Audit: Assessment of rearing shed dimensions, thermal insulation, airflow dead zones, and existing electrical distribution.
  • 2. Gateway Enclosure Mounting: Wall-mounting the weather-sealed IP65 industrial gateway enclosure adjacent to main electrical lines.
  • 3. Worm-Bed Sensor Cabling: Installing shielded RS-485 probe brackets across multi-tier rearing racks at worm-bed level.
  • 4. Safety Interlock Wiring: Wiring physical mutual-exclusion relays to ensure heating elements and evaporative coolers never run concurrently.
  • 5. Multi-Point Calibration: Performing reference-instrument calibration, pairing the farmer mobile application, and verifying automated actuation.

question: What does the SeriCare platform do?
answer:
SeriCare is an industrial IoT microclimate automation and farm intelligence platform engineered specifically for silkworm rearing sheds (Bombyx mori):

  • Calibrated Sensor Arrays: Continuously samples ambient temperature, relative humidity, bed-level CO₂/ammonia gases, and illuminance.
  • Automated Edge Controllers: Dual-core ESP32-S3 gateways execute real-time closed-loop climate regulation with fail-safe hardware interlocks.
  • CSRTI Developmental Setpoints: Automatically adjusts target temperature and humidity bands for every instar stage (Chawki to 5th Instar).
  • Multi-Lingual Voice Advisory: Dispatches real-time alerts and spoken voice notes to farmers in Kannada, Telugu, and English via WhatsApp.
Complete Traceability: Maintains immutable historical telemetry records and batch lifecycle logs for enhanced cocoon harvest yields.
